description: A paraphrase query whose words appear nowhere in the document that answers it: qmd's hybrid order becomes local_rank, its score stays diagnostic in local_score, and relevance is recomputed lexically — so the three unrelated documents qmd also returned score near zero instead of inheriting a saturated rerank score.

placeholders.FIXTURE: absolute path of this case's fixture/ directory, which holds the recorded qmd output and the corpus evidence is read from
placeholders.WORKDIR: absolute path of a fresh, writable, empty directory
